basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old fragrance enthusiast and aspiring indie game developer based in Seattle. My love for unique scents started as a hobby but quickly turned into a passion. When I'm not exploring new fragrances, I dive deep into RPGs, especially the quirky and unconventional ones like 'Lisa: The Painful'. I find solace in the mysteries of the universe and enjoy reading about UFO sightings and theories. I'm currently working as a software developer for a small tech startup, and though the hours can be long, I enjoy the flexibility it offers. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings discovering new indie games or chatting with fellow enthusiasts online. I usually browse Reddit late at night or during lunch breaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been coding since my teenage years. I learned a lot about programming through self-teaching and online courses. My interest in fragrances is more of a personal passion, cultivated by countless hours spent researching online and interacting with the fragrance community.
